Simple chicken and vegetable soup

Ingredients

1 tablespoon oil 
1 tablespoon butter 
2 boneless chicken breasts, diced, 10-12 ounces 
1/2 cup green pepper, chopped, 2 ounces 
1/2 cup celery, sliced thin, 2 small stalks 
1/4 cup onion, chopped, 1 1/4 ounces 
2 cans chicken broth or 4 cups homemade broth 
1/2 cup water 
1/2 cup carrots, sliced, 2 1/2 ounces or 1 medium carrot
1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped 
1/4 teaspoon pepper 
Salt, to taste

Directions

Heat the oil and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chicken; cook and stir 4-5 minutes or just until no longer pink. Add the green pepper, celery and onions. Cook and stir 7 minutes or until the vegetables are tender crisp. Add the broth, water, carrots, parsley, pepper and salt. Simmer, uncovered, 15-20 minutes or until the carrots are tender.

SPOILERS: DON'T READ UNLESS YOU FINISHED THE GAME I just finished the game and I understand the basic plot, but I still feel confused about a lot of things. Was Eve the one who killed everyone else as well? (death caps, stairs, heatwave) Does anyone think Her Story is a prologue for a potential bigger game series? What was the whole deal about reflections and palindromes? Why did that bother her so much.

Does anyone else have other theories? I know one of the more prevalent ones was a split personality, but it doesn't work with her having a tattoo and bruise.
I don't think the story is 100% conclusive. It's really open to interpretation.

I think Eve killed everyone. I think she killed Florence, her parents, caused Hannah's miscarriage, killed Simon and then killed Hannah, followed by blaming the only murder the police knew about on Hannah.

For me it all starts with Eve lying about Hannah knowing that Eve and Simon were sleeping together, and that Simon was the father of Eve's child. During one of the interviews, where it's definitely Hannah being interviewed, she's shocked that they found a 3rd person's fingerprints in her bedroom. These fingerprints are Eve's since twins don't share the same fingerprints.

Once you pull that thread, everything else about Eve's version of events unravels. Hannah no longer has a motivation to impersonate Eve in front of Simon to gauge his reaction. Hannah no longer has a motivation to murder Simon, even in a fit of passion. Hannah no longer has any motivation to try to protect Eve for Simon's child's sake. But now Eve has plenty of motive.

When talking about Carl, Eve talks about how much they fought over him, but that once he was gone, she realized what was really important, family. Eve also makes a remake about how things they don't need anymore end up in the cellar. What that culminates in is that Simon was about to come between Eve and Hannah far worse than he already was, and he had to go. Eve murdered Simon to restore her relationship with her sister Hannah.

I think another lie Eve told during her final interview was characterizing Hannah as the more violent one. She tells a story where Hannah and Eve always had to replicate each other's injuries, but that sometimes Hannah would take it too far. I think this role was actually reversed. It's part of Eve trying to pin Simon's murder on Hannah. I think in actuality, Eve was the one who would excessively beat Hannah. Eve got the initial bruise during a struggle with Simon, and then she beat the ever loving shit out of Hannah afterwards. Eve's bruise healed by the time she was interviewed by the police, Hannah's wasn't even close. Which is why Eve went in initially, probably at Hannah's insistence.

I find more support for this in the fact that Hannah constantly seems stiff and terrified when speaking of events that involve Eve. The one time she got to live without Eve, during her wedding, she talks about how relieved she felt. But she also talks about how guilty she felt when her parents died. She remarks that she should have stayed at home, and if she had, they'd still be alive. Hannah knows Eve is dangerous, and she's terrified of her, and likely abused by her. It's all the more obvious in the stereotypical "Oh, I hit myself with a door, I'm so clumsy" excuse for her bruise when the cops question her.

I'm not even convinced Hannah knew Eve killed Simon. I think it's possible Hannah honestly discovered his body, since we don't see her until after the body was discovered, on the 3rd session, and her bruise hasn't healed yet. It's an obvious tell she was probably too distraught to care about. I also think the fight she had that drove her out of the house on her birthday wasn't with Simon, but with Eve. This left Eve alone in the house with Simon. Afterwards, Eve might have gone on her little Glasgow trip to establish a paper trail during the supposed time of the murder.

I think it's also telling that when Hannah tells a version of events about he Glasgow trip, she leaves out the pregnancy and hospital visit, only referencing being pregnant in a later interview after Eve spilled the beans. I think it's possible Hannah didn't know Eve was pregnant until that very moment, when it was vital for the charade that Eve finally tell Hannah.

Anyways, that's my excessive brain dump. I need to rewatch all the videos again for more evidence, either for or against this theory.
